decisions.reason: The added assessment outputs and document-review coverage do not change the independently stated requirement to implement the new style system across all templates.
The assessment deliverables do not modify the specified bullet size, balance, alignment, or scaling requirements.
Reviewing files and providing assessment outputs does not alter the independently established legacy copy-paste stability behavior, test sources, or V14 target.
The assessment-output change does not modify the required Tab-key behavior or list-hierarchy alignment.
The added assessment outputs and coverage do not change the requirement for reliable manual line breaks after pasted content.
The assessment requirements do not modify the table-layout stability requirement or its existing reported failure; both are independently stated in the same source message.
